_instructions.purpose: Optional story-specific editorial art and grounded interactives. Keys are exact Daily Star source URLs.
_instructions.hero: Use base without extension, e.g. assets/story-covers/example. Upload matching .webp and optionally .avif files.
_instructions.inline: Modules can be inserted after a specific paragraph with after_paragraph. Supported: pullquote, explainer, timeline, chart, table.
_instructions.documents: Optional source-document links shown in the Evidence & Context sidebar block.
_instructions.rule: Only add facts, figures, dates and quotations supported by the story or a verified source.
